newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile sets new electricity distribution prices.
newsitem.headline: Chile sets new electricity distribution prices.

text.p: Chile fixed new electricity distribution prices on Wednesday, which will go in force from July 1.
The notice in the government gazette details the formula for setting the rates which will be much lower than existing prices.
The prices were due to have been published in November but were delayed after a legal appeal by four power companies against the new tariffs.
Companies will have to reimburse customers for excess power charges for the November-July period while the new prices were being set.
